paragraphs: Before work, inspect brakes and limit switches and verify that the load is within capacity. Follow commands to lift slowly, control movement, and monitor the hook and wire rope. Reduce speed before landing and align precisely with the target. Record operating time and load at shift handover.

Hoist and winch operators focus on professional execution and accountability. Managers emphasize decisions, researchers emphasize insight, and support roles emphasize process. The distinction concerns outputs and responsibility boundaries, not simply hierarchy.

Not entirely. AI absorbs many structured tasks, but people retain real-world judgment, final accountability, and interpersonal coordination. Professional depth and judgment provide the durable advantage (AI exposure: 3/10).
